items.title: How are signals of extracellular stress relayed to lysosomes?

image.alt: Diagram: preliminary data show that Tfeb and Tfe3 only activate lysosomal signaling in response to cellular stress in microglia and macrophages. A genome-wide CRISPR screen in macrophages challenged with synaptosomes, myelin debris, or misfolded proteins aims to uncover upstream activators of lysosomal and endosomal biogenesis.

items.title: What are the key molecular differences in the endolysosomal pathway between professional and non-professional phagocytic cells?

image.alt: Diagram comparing professional phagocytic cells (monocytes, macrophages, microglia, and dendritic cells) with non-professional phagocytic cells (epithelial cells, fibroblasts, and endothelial cells): phagocytic potential in development and aging, signals that confer phagocytic capacity and plasticity, endolysosomal pathway components, and cell death by phagocytosis.
